mapper.insert: INSERT INTO predictions (created_at, game_date, home_team, away_team, stage, home_win_prob, base_home_prob, range_low, range_high, draw_prob, games, home_starter, away_starter, home_lineup, away_lineup) VALUES (#{createdAt}, #{gameDate}, #{homeTeam}, #{awayTeam}, #{stage}, #{homeWinProb}, #{baseHomeProb}, #{rangeLow}, #{rangeHigh}, #{drawProb}, #{games}, #{homeStarter}, #{awayStarter}, #{homeLineup}, #{awayLineup})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.created_at, p.game_date, p.home_team, p.away_team, p.stage, p.home_win_prob, p.base_home_prob, p.range_low, p.range_high, p.home_starter, p.away_starter, (SELECT MIN(s.start_time) FROM schedule s WHERE s.date = p.game_date AND s.home_team = p.home_team AND s.away_team = p.away_team) AS start_time, r.home_score, r.away_score, r.source AS result_source FROM predictions p LEFT JOIN game_results r ON r.game_date = p.game_date AND r.home_team = p.home_team AND r.away_team = p.away_team ORDER BY p.game_date DESC, p.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_results (game_date, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, source, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameDate}, #{homeTeam}, #{awayTeam}, #{homeScore}, #{awayScore}, 'manual', #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE home_score = IF(source = 'import', home_score, VALUES(home_score)), away_score = IF(source = 'import', away_score, VALUES(away_score)), updated_at = IF(source = 'import', updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
